data.body: PLAN_AMENDMENT: Attestation sample is a human-curated subset for human review -- NOT curator agent output. Select >= 5 records from the holdout set manually to serve as ground-truth examples for human reviewers. Each entry should include reviewer_verdict: PENDING and a notes field for the reviewer to fill in. The manual:awaiting_user tag signals that a human must review this sample and mark incidents as valid/invalid before the story can close. Do not attempt to run the inference-incident-curator agent as part of this task.
